retrieval.text: # Run a12n-server (OAuth2/OIDC) locally with MFA-ready defaults and verify core endpoints ## Background a12n-server is a lightweight authentication server implementing OAuth2 and OpenID Connect. It supports multiple authentication methods including MFA (TOTP, email one-time codes, WebAuthn) and provides standard OAuth2/OIDC endpoints such as discovery, JWKS, token introspection, and token revocation. Project note: the repository indicates the project is being retired; consider evaluating alternatives (for example, Keycloak) for new long-term deployments. ## Use Cases - Spin up a local OAuth2/OIDC provider for development and integration testing. - Validate OIDC discovery and JWKS endpoints for a client integration. - Stand up an auth server that supports MFA methods (TOTP/email/WebAuthn) for prototyping. - Smoke-test OAuth2/OIDC metadata endpoints in CI (where a local server is acceptable). ## Inputs - Node.js version greater than 18.x - A working directory to hold generated configuration and a SQLite database - Network access to fetch the npm package via npx ## Outputs - A generated server configuration file in the working directory - A generated SQLite database in the working dir
